g.text: i shows what the highlighted entry runs and how risky it is · enter runs it (you confirm first) · a adds
your own. Details and results appear here.
↑↓ select · enter run · a add · m edit · space on/off · x delete · i details · c what the target allows ·
s re-sync · e enable exec · d disable · t telemetry · r rollback last · esc back
